mapper.sql: SELECT t.id, upper(encode(t.uid, 'hex')) AS uid, t.label, t.type, t.branch_id, t.status, t.last_tap_at, t.last_counter, (SELECT k.key_version FROM nfc_tag_keys k WHERE k.tag_id = t.id AND k.status = 'ACTIVE') AS active_key_version, (SELECT k.key_version FROM nfc_tag_keys k WHERE k.tag_id = t.id AND k.status = 'PENDING') AS pending_key_version, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nfc_tag_keys k WHERE k.tag_id = t.id AND k.status = 'PENDING' AND k.provisioning_exported_at IS NOT NULL) AS pending_exported, (SELECT count(*) FROM tap_events e WHERE e.tag_id = t.id AND e.stage = 'VERIFY' AND e.outcome = 'ACCEPTED' AND e.created_at >= #{since}) AS taps_last7_days, t.created_at, (t.type = 'SIMULATED' OR (SELECT count(*) FROM nfc_tags o WHERE o.type <> 'SIMULATED' AND (o.created_at, o.id) < (t.created_at, t.id)) < #{freeTags}) AS free FROM nfc_tags t
mapper.select: ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM nfc_tags WHERE type <> 'SIMULATED'
SELECT id, name FROM branches WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM branches WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE')
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nfc_tags WHERE uid = #{uid})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nfc_tags (id, branch_id, uid, type, label, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{branchId}, #{uid}, 'NTAG424_SUN', #{label}, 'ACTIVE', #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE nfc_tags SET label = COALESCE(#{label}, label), branch_id = COALESCE(#{branchId}, branch_id), updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE nfc_tags SET status = #{status}, disabled_at = #{disabledAt}, disabled_by = NULL, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nfc_tag_keys (id, tag_id, key_version, status, app_master_key_enc, meta_read_key_enc, file_read_key_enc, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tagId}, #{version}, 'PENDING', #{appMasterKeyEnc}, #{metaReadKeyEnc}, #{fileReadKeyEnc}, NULL, #{now})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM nfc_tag_keys WHERE tag_id = #{tagId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND provisioning_exported_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT coalesce(max(key_version), 0) + 1 FROM nfc_tag_keys WHERE tag_id = #{tagId}
SELECT count(*) FROM tap_events WHERE tag_id = #{tagId}
